runtime.RSS_policy: sample R process-tree RSS every 0.5s; abort infrastructure task on >1.5GiB; no invented result or new replicate

gamm.target: Gaussian identity CAR1 working-model smoothed trend of actually observed scores, not empirical or counterfactual cohort mean
gamm.statistics: pointwise fitted curve at actual integer minute grid; no clipping or derivative bands

complete.target: raw VAS covariance of interval-complete true people
complete.centering: training population minute mean; no within-person standardization

reconstruction.baseline: each heldout full curve individual weighted constant, same weights and target rows
reconstruction.aggregation: mean across people within each repeat; complete repeats only; failures retained
reconstruction.role: whole-curve reconstruction and split sensitivity; not forecasting or population CI

sparse.target: working smoothed mean/covariance of observed raw VAS under noninformative observation assumptions; selection unresolved
sparse.fve: compute denominator from all positive eigenvalues of smoothed covariance; do not normalize only the first four
sparse.subspace: weighted QR orthonormalization before principal angles because package functions need not be exactly trapezoid-orthogonal

MC.scope: separate module MC precision only; successful-fit conditional descriptive ranges, no nominal coverage validation

RNG.indices: SHA256(master|R_frame|replicate|subject_multiplicity), numpy SeedSequence PCG64 index draws; explicit zero-based subject rows passed to R
RNG.reference_and_fit: SHA256 logical module/cell/replicate folded to R signed 31-bit seed; per-replicate reset independent of batch or worker
RNG.shared_draws: same cohort and interval share subject index streams across model/bandwidth specifications

followup_policy.pilot_used_for: budget planning only; no merging or selection of favorable endpoints
followup_policy.planning_approximation: old_B * (old_max_endpoint_half_width / min(.02*old_range_width, absolute_target))^2; local inverse-root-B heuristic, no guarantee
followup_policy.GAMM_sparse: diagnostics/planning only in this stage; no bootstrap execution
